$comment: CI should overwrite data/evals.json on each gated release. Do not treat a hand-edited copy as the source of truth. The intended job is documented, and disabled, in .github/workflows/update-evals.yml. lastRun and releaseId are null until that job writes them.
title: Published evaluation evidence

releaseId.description: Release identifier from CI. Null until CI writes it. Do not invent one.

lastRun.description: UTC date of the last gated eval run (YYYY-MM-DD). Null until CI writes it.

status.description: CI should set pass only when the release gate succeeded, and fail otherwise.

basis.description: One sentence a reviewer can check. CI should replace this with the gate that actually ran.

reading.description: One line per term, written for a procurement reader. Keep in step with the scores CI writes.
